description: Issues are nice. Politics has turned ugly. Politicians no longer discuss issues thoughtfully, instead they throw poison darts at their opponents. They assume if they can make you hate or fear their opponents, that's a win for them. I think otherwise. I think voters want an honest conversation with their elected representatives, a thoughtful conversation that seeks to reach a consensus on how to achieve our common goals. Welcome to the conversation.
